notes.title: Eriksholm: The Stolen Dream – Bug Fix Update
notes.content: [p]Hi everyone! [/p][p]We’ve just released a patch for [i]Eriksholm: The Stolen Dream[/i] with a number of fixes and improvements based on your feedback. Thank you so much for playing and sharing your thoughts – it helps us make the game better for everyone!💛 [/p][p][/p][p]Here’s what’s included in the latest update: [/p][p][/p][p][b]Bug Fixes & Improvements[/b] [/p][list][*][p]Fixed a number of possible soft locks  [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed body placement when dragging someone  [/p][/*][*][p]Vent leaving logic on Mouse and Keyboard controls have been updated to have better pathfinding when clicking far away from the vent exit  [/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted chapter complete for the final level to trigger after last cutscene instead of after credits  [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with lingering animations not ending as intended [/p][/*][*][p]Several fixes and adjustments to improve visuals and fix glitches  [/p][/*][*][p]Optimizations to several areas to improve performance [/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]As always, please keep your feedback coming and let us know if you encounter any issues. Thanks again for your support and for being part of the Eriksholm journey!  [/p][p][/p][p]– The River End Games & Nordcurrent Labs Teams [/p]
